text:
alex: FYI seeing a sharp drop in available GPUs in us-east-1 shard-14, traffic started failing over to other regions ~10:12 UTC. metrics look sparse. ops-bot: alert: GPU_CAPACITY_DROP shard-14 at 1755004340 :rotating_light:
maria: I can confirm Prom scrape for shard-14 stopped around 10:11, prometheus shows last successful scrape at 10:10. no logs from node-exporter during that window. :thinking:
sara: checked k8s node statuses — kubelet shows flaps on 3 nodes in shard-14 and a CNI flapping event around 10:09. kernel dmesg shows a bunch of netlink errors.
noah: traces are also incomplete for that timeframe, spans around kv-cache miss/hit counters are missing. possible correlation with exporter outage.
alex: ops-bot posted a deployment rollback in the cluster at 10:08, could that have touched configmaps for prometheus relabeling?
maria: yes, there was a relabel tweak that removed pod IP relabeling for a short-lived canary. seems the relabel accidentally filtered out node-exporter targets in shard-14. I missed the canary guardrail. :facepalm:
sara: so we had a three-way hit: CNI flaps -> exporter pod restarts -> scrape relabel drop. explains missing metrics + fragmented traces.
noah: what about logs? we seem to have a gap in fluentd ingestion 10:09-10:16 for that shard. fluentd shows an OOM restart counter around then. logs rotated and some were lost by the node-level logrotate config.
alex: timeline: 10:08 config roll -> 10:09 CNI flaps -> 10:10 exporter pod restarts + fluentd OOM -> 10:11 prometheus scrapes filtered -> 10:12 traffic shifted. makes sense.
maria: immediate fix: revert the relabel change and reapply stable config to prometheus. I'll roll the revert to canary environment now and then shard-14.
sara: I'll cordon the 3 flaky nodes and drain them to force scheduling elsewhere to stop the CNI churn. also increasing kubelet log level to capture more netlink details during repro.
noah: I'll restart the otel-collector for shard-14 to backfill traces, and recreate fluentd pods with memory limits bumped to prevent OOM.
ops-bot: runbook check: incident template 'region-instrumentation-gap' assigned to alex.
alex: short commands I ran: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo configmap/prometheus-relabel --to-revision=3` and `kubectl -n shard-14 rollout restart daemonset/node-exporter`.
maria: sample relabel fix we reverted (for posterity):
```
- job_name: 'node-exporter'
  static_configs:
  - targets: ['<node_ip>:9100']
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_role]
    regex: node
    action: keep
```
we accidentally added an extra `source_labels` filter for environment that excluded the canary nodes.
sara: notes on instrumentation gap: we currently have single-point-of-failure in the prometheus relabeling logic. proposal: add a fallback scrape config that uses node metadata (instance id) as a last-resort target list so missing pod labels don't take down scrapes for an entire shard. also add exporter liveness probe with an explicit prometheus metric endpoint check.
noah: and for traces/logs: make otel-collector checkpoint on disk when ingestion backlog exceeds threshold so we don't lose spans during short outages; also adjust fluentd memory request/limit to avoid OOMs during spikes.
alex: agree. short-term actions: revert relabel (done), restart exporters (in progress), restart fluentd/otel (in progress), cordon nodes (sara). Medium-term: relabel fallback, exporter liveness, fluentd mem bump, otel checkpointing.
maria: I'll open a PR for relabel fallback and a canary rollout plan. tagging @sre-reviewers.
sara: I'll put together a small k8s runbook update for node flapping + instrumentation gaps and add a checklist for rollbacks.
noah: I'll instrument a synthetic probe that hits the exporter endpoint and a synthetic trace through the request path; wire alerts to oncall so gaps are visible.
ops-bot: incident state -> mitigation in progress, severity lowered to P2 at 10:30 UTC.
alex: final note: we lost ~6 minutes of observability in shard-14 which made triage slower. we should track MTTR delta if fallback relabel/probe implemented. assigning owners in the postmortem. :memo:
maria: PR link will be posted in this thread when ready.
sara: adding follow-up action items to the ops board.
noah: thumbs up, will follow up with instrumentation tests. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks everyone. continuing to monitor shard-14 until nodes stable.
